purpose: Teach: うたっ/短所/ふえる/ぼけ/なつ/やれやれ/人当たり/留まっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、カラオケで、お前と、うたった夜、本当に、楽しかったよね、また、行こうよ、絶対。
lines.en: That night at karaoke with you was so much fun, Riku. We have to go again. Seriously.
lines.style: Warm and direct, eyes bright with the memory. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm — not performing. Slight emphasis on 'seriously' like she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前、短所を、自分で、わかってるって、すごいよ、桜、リーダーシップ、本気で、感じるよ。
lines.en: Yeah. It's amazing how you actually see your own weaknesses, Sakura. Your leadership — I really feel it.
lines.style: Soft and sincere. The words come a beat slower, like he's been holding them. Steady eye contact. Not dramatic — just honest, a little vulnerable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、クラスのメンバー、ふえることが、結構、あるよね、リク、お前、ご存知?転校生、続いてる。
lines.en: The class has been getting new members lately, haven't we? Did you know? We keep getting transfer students.
lines.style: Casual shift in topic, conversational. Curious but not pressing — testing the water. Light pace, natural as if she's just thinking out loud with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、最近、ぼけてきたんだ、桜、お前にも、お話、したかったんだ、本当に、心配。
lines.en: My grandfather has been getting forgetful lately, Sakura. I've wanted to tell you about it. I'm actually worried.
lines.style: Quiet, serious turn inward. Slower pace. The admission costs something — voice softens on 'worried'. Trusting her with this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なつ、転校生の子、本当に、明るい子で、皆、すぐ、仲良くなったよ、リク、紹介してあげる、絶対。
lines.en: There's this transfer student, Natsu — she's really bright. Everyone warmed up to her right away. I should introduce you two, Riku.
lines.style: Animated and bright again, energy shifting back up. Quick delivery, genuinely pleased. Like she's already picturing them getting along.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やれやれ、テスト、本当に、難しかったよな、桜、お互いに、頑張ったけど、結果、心配だな、本気で。
lines.en: That test was honestly brutal, wasn't it? We both tried hard, but the results… I'm genuinely worried about them.
lines.style: Wry acceptance of shared pain. Slight sardonic edge on the opening. Self-aware about the struggle. Not complaining — just being real about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の人当たり、本当に、いいよね、リク、誰とでも、すぐ、仲良くなれるよね、本気で、すごい、絶対。
lines.en: You're really good with people, you know that? You get along with anyone, Riku. Seriously — it's amazing.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, warmth underneath. Steady voice, not overstating it. The words land as fact, not flattery. Small pause before 'seriously' for emphasis.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日のお前のメッセージ、ちょっと、留まったんだ、桜、心配かけて、ごめん、すぐ、返事、しないとな、本気で。
lines.en: I saw your message from yesterday. I know I didn't reply right away — I'm sorry for worrying you. I should have written back sooner.
lines.style: Quiet regret, slight defensiveness softening into apology. Slower, more careful. Not excusing himself, just explaining. Genuine contrition.
